# Creative Wizard (marketing page)

> AI design studio for home textiles that only proposes what manufacturing
> development can actually weave, tuft, print or stitch. Made by Binder 33 Labs
> Private Limited in Panipat, India — the home-textile belt — for manufacturers,
> exporters, buying houses and design studios.

This page is the marketing overview of Creative Wizard. The product itself lives
at https://creative-wizards.com — its authoritative agent brief, including
current pricing, is https://creative-wizards.com/llms.txt.

Creative Wizard turns a plain-words brief into production-ready home-textile
designs — bedsheets, towels, curtains, rugs, cushions, throws, aprons, table
linen and more. Unlike generic image generators, every design is grounded in
real manufacturing: a 60-machine skills library (jacquard, dobby, terry,
tufting, printing, embroidery and others), yarn counts, EPI/PPI and GSM
arithmetic, and a physics check that flags anything a loom cannot honestly do —
it informs, it never blocks. Designs come with a spec sheet a production team
can read, a manufacturability read (shade separation against lab-dip tolerance,
colour-station ceilings, repeat fit against real product dimensions), and an
optional production file pack: true-size TIFF with DPI in the header, tiled
proof, colourway card, one zip.

## Who it is for

Home-textile manufacturers and exporters, buyers and buying houses, and textile
design studios that need buyer-ready, manufacturable concepts in minutes instead
of sampling cycles.

- Legal entity: Binder 33 Labs Private Limited, Panipat, Haryana, India
- Sign-in: Google or email
- Billing: INR (GST-inclusive) and USD plans, credit top-ups, enterprise
  workspaces; a design that fails is never charged
